profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a highly experienced and versatile software engineer with expertise in software engineering, operations, and project management. I have a proven track record of developing, executing, and scaling successful software engineering projects aligned to organizational objectives with a focus on continuous process improvements, measurable deliverables, and quality assurance. I am deeply dedicated to self-reflection and personal improvement and exceeding key performance metrics. 

RESULTS: I recently oversaw a portfolio of software engineering responsibilities on a transaction processing SaaS product, overseeing the product lifecycle management and successful growth from $30MM in annual recurring revenue to $110MM in 5 years.

RESULTS-DRIVEN, CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATOR: I am a collaborative and relationships-focused team leader with the goal of continually increased productivity and consistent outcome attainment.

CONTACT ME: johnson.lee.tom @gmail.com

Specialties:

INDUSTRY SKILLS: ✰ Quality Assurance ✰ Operational Processes ✰ Test Automation ✰ Project Management ✰ Cross-Functional Leadership ✰ Software Engineering ✰ Risk Mitigation ✰ Data & Analytics ✰ Stakeholder Management ✰ Strategic Planning ✰.NET Framework ✰ Efficiency Improvements


PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES:  Proactive ✰ Versatile ✰ Resourceful ✰ Detail-Oriented ✰  Dynamic ✰  Analytical ✰ Strategic ✰ Collaborative ✰ Motivated ✰ Excellent Communication Skills ✰ Organized ✰ Self-Starter ✰ Leader ✰ Problem-Solver

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer (2022-Present)
Selected Achievements:

Lead critical code optimization initiative that reduced provider page load times from 20+ seconds to under 1 second, cutting SQL Server CPU usage by 75% and dramatically improving system performance and user experience.

Helped drive the end-to-end development and launch of the Provider Invoicing system which has processed over $1 billion in provider payments since going live before handing off to customer invoicing team.

Architected and developed a communications intelligence platform that ingests email, telephony, and SMS data, enabling enterprise-wide search and discovery. Led development of the core analysis service, implementing entity extraction and correlation workflows that automatically identified participants and linked communications to customers, providers, and work orders across multiple business systems.

Identified and traced rounding discrepancies in provider invoices to upstream system logic during an internal audit, delivering actionable insights to management and contributing to system-wide accuracy improvements.
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Selected Achievements:

Oversaw a portfolio of software engineering responsibilities on a transaction processing SaaS product, overseeing the product lifecycle management and successful growth from $30MM in annual recurring revenue to $110MM in 5 years.

Collaborated on a cross-functional team of 7 staff, helping drive a team KPI achievement of 99%, receiving formal recognition as a “Star” and consistently having 100% of peer code review suggestions accepted.

Supported the rewrite of the organization’s entire eligibility software in C# and MS SQL from Universe, cutting processing time by 50%, reducing costs by $30k/yr (retiring licenses) and enabling $80MM+ in additional revenue.

Deployed a series of operational and cost optimization improvements, including a new automated systems health dashboard ($40,000/yr labor savings), and a transaction back-up alert system (95% decreased support call volume).

Acted as sole developer for converting transaction IDs from int to big int, assessing >500,000 lines of code and writing SQL to migrate 6.7 billion entries, completing the project 6 months ahead of schedule with <30 mins of downtime.

positions.title: Software QA & QA Architect
positions.description:
Selected Achievements:

Led a portfolio of test automation and framework development responsibilities for 14 teams working on 12 projects valued at $500MM/yr, launching an automated organizational framework which is still in use and has saved more than $450,000/yr in labor per year for the last 11 years ($4.9MM savings).

Built the organization’s first automated testing systems from the ground up, eliminating the need for 7 FTE professionals while improving the quality of testing by approx. 10% and reducing processing time by 90%.

Managed a team of 10 cross-functional quality assurance professionals, overseeing a team KPI achievement of >90% and a staff retention rate of 100%, leading professional development to increase staff capacity on test automation.

Supported non-technical staff in the usage of technical assets, including frameworks, automated testing, and simple scripts, assisting dozens of employees in building basic capacity to improve productivity by 5-10%.

positions.title: Testing Tools Specialist
positions.description:
Selected Achievements:
Led a portfolio of quality assurance and testing tools solutions for a product line responsible for serving more than 2 million clients, handling $6.5 Billion in transactions  each year, assisting a team of 7 quality assurance specialists.

Created a call tracking software program which was utilized as a de facto CRM, eliminating the need for paper note tracking and filing, saving $100,000/labor a year.

Built internal capacity in Java by teaching staff about developing test automation and creating regression tests, the expanded staff capacity allowed for several new tool developments.

Launched a test tracking software to store testing results for the quality assurance team, allowing for better cross-functional communication between developers on key bugs and issues, reducing time-to-resolution by 10% YoY.

positions.title: Relationship Support Liaison
positions.description:
Selected Achievements:

Designed an Excel VBA application to generate test files, reducing the test time from 3 days to < 30 seconds and eliminating multiple manual processes.

Acted as lead stakeholder manager with 5 external partners, ensuring 100% audit and regulatory compliance related to certification of files and file processing for client taxes.
